messages.author: bebd85531a67ef86
messages.subject: could not find function "extractControlElement"
parts:
Dear nimble users

I am doing some MCMC with the RW_llFunction_block sampler - everything works fine. 

I want to do some minor customisation to sampler_RW_llFunction_block, so I have...
1) copied it to a script 
2) renamed it sampler_RW_llFunction_block_custom. 
3) used the new name in the addSampler line
4) done no other changes to the function - only it's name and location have changed so far.  

Now when I do buildMCMC(mcmcConf) I get the error message

Error in extractControlElement(control, "adaptive", TRUE) (from #6) : 
  could not find function "extractControlElement"

This corresponds to the very first lines of the setup code. So I imagine that this could be a  namespace / environment issue. For some reason, renaming & copy/pasting the function has resulted in an inability to access standard nimble functions used in setup. 

I don't know if this is a relevant information, but the data objects I am using in my script are created in a drake plan and loaded into the R session with drake's loadd function.  Packages are being loaded via pacman::p_load(). I've attached the output from sessionInfo()

Any idea?

Cheers
David

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: could not find function "extractControlElement"
parts:
David, thanks for the error report.

The function "extractControlElement" is a recent addition to the package.  This function should be exported when you load nimble.  Can you first just check whether:

library(nimble)
extractControlElement

is able to locate the function "extractControlElement" ?  It should, after the package is loaded, but perhaps something is going awry as a result of using pacman::p_load() ?

Another thing - did you change the "name" field of your new sampler, "sampler_RW_llFunction_block_custom", which usually is about the 2nd or 3rd line of the sampler declaration, to match the name of your new sampler, specifically, as:
...
name = 'sampler_RW_llFunction_block_custom',
...

? I'm not sure this would make the difference, but I thought I'd mention it.

Finally, I've created my own example, mimicking what (I believe) you're trying to do - see below.  It seems to work fine for me.

I hope we can figure this out without delay.

Cheers,
Daniel


library(nimble)

sampler_NEW <- nimbleFunction(
    name = 'sampler_NEW',
    contains = sampler_BASE,
    setup = function(model, mvSaved, target, control) {
        controlElement <- extractControlElement(control, 'controlElement', 0)
    },
    run = function() { print('unfortunately, this sampler doesnt do anything') },
    methods = list( reset = function() { } )
)

code <- nimbleCode({ a ~ dnorm(0, 1) })
Rmodel <- nimbleModel(code)

conf <- configureMCMC(Rmodel)
conf$printSamplers()
conf$addSampler(target = 'a', type = 'NEW')
conf$printSamplers()
Rmcmc <- buildMCMC(conf)   ## works fine

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: could not find function "extractControlElement"
parts:
Aha, yes, you're using version 0.9.1 of nimble, the most recent release which is on CRAN, and I'm assuming you installed it from CRAN. This change to the MCMC wasn't in that release, and hence the function "extractControlElement" isn't there (in the version of nimble you're using) at all.  Furthermore, I'm guessing you copied the source code for the "RW_llFunction_block" sampler from GitHub, from the development (the default) branch, which has this change to the MCMC.  So the version of NIMBLE you're using isn't compatible with the sample source code you copied.  So you have a bunch of easy options:

(1) Install the development version of nimble, from GitHub... code below.  Then your sampler should work fine (meaning, not have this problem, at least).
remove.packages('nimble')
library(devtools)
install_github('nimble-dev/nimble', ref = 'devel', subdir = 'packages/nimble')
library(nimble)

(2) Copy the older version of the "RW_llFunction_block" function from the version 0.9.1 version of nimble, available here:
https://github.com/nimble-dev/nimble/blob/v0.9.1/packages/nimble/R/MCMC_samplers.R

(3) Or, just define the "extractControlElement" function locally, the code for the (current) version of it is below:

extractControlElement <- function(controlList, elementName, defaultValue, error) {
    if(missing(controlList) | !is.list(controlList))      stop('extractControlElement: controlList argument must be a list')
    if(missing(elementName) | !is.character(elementName)) stop('extractControlElement: elementName argument must be a character string variable name')
    if(missing(defaultValue) & missing(error))            stop('extractControlElement: must provide either defaultValue or error argument')
    if(elementName %in% names(controlList)) {
        return(controlList[[elementName]])
    } else {
        if(!missing(defaultValue)) return(defaultValue) else stop(error)
    }
}
